title: Trust, Destination Risk and Abuse
case_ids_frozen_by: P16 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P16-Txxx identifiers

inherited_authorities: P05 normalized reachable-target fingerprint and redirect risk-before-routing ordering
P09 Files quarantine/mandatory ClamAV fail-closed authority; ClamAV is not a URL classifier
capability_contract.scope: P16 closes its scanning/provider/review/override/revalidation/public-report/resource-risk governance contributions without re-owning P05 routing/A-B, P06 domain axes, P09 file scanning, P12 notification center, P15 auth/session or P17 administrator/permission lifecycle. P17 and release-wide G10/G13 remain later-owned where specified.

inherited_seam_authority.scope: These blobs are inherited behavioral seams at the P16 base. P16 may integrate with them but cannot weaken target-set fingerprint semantics, risk-before-routing ordering or independent domain-axis readiness.

rules: No legacy trust/safety aliases or silent compatibility routes may be invented.
Public safety and abuse surfaces are noindex; abuse intake is no-store; safety surfaces never disclose unsafe target/provider evidence/thresholds/bypass instructions.
Admin trust surfaces are no-store/noindex and consume dedicated server permissions; UI visibility is never authorization.
P16 consumes security.manage and domains.risk.manage without implementing P17 administrator/role/permission lifecycle.
P19 retains final Website/Security/Legal content and technical SEO ownership.
Reachable target authority is inherited from P05: normalized primary plus every enabled routing and enabled A/B destination form one deterministic exact fingerprint.
Only exact-current allow may proceed; every other state fails closed before routing, A/B, UTM, password, expiry, click-limit and one-time logic.
Any reachable target mutation invalidates prior authority immediately; semantically equivalent reorder/deduplication does not create false approval.
Official and custom hostnames use the identical destination-risk contract.
Durable policy/provider observations are projected to Redis runtime state only when exact fingerprint, policy version and validity remain current.
External semantic/reputation providers are signals only and cannot be sole allow authority.
Target inspection resolves and validates every connection address server-side before connecting.
Redirect chains are revalidated hop-by-hop and cannot redirect from public to denied address space.
DNS rebinding and mixed public/private answer sets fail closed according to the security policy.
Provider endpoints come only from reviewed server configuration; arbitrary client provider URLs are prohibited.
Domain risk remains independent from entitlement, ownership, ingress DNS and HTTPS.
P16 owns reputation/provider/revalidation contribution; P06 domain identity and other axes remain inherited.
Provider outage/partial/malformed/stale evidence never becomes allow.
Security/abuse suspension is immediate and receives no billing/domain grace.
User-facing reasons are allowlisted categories; raw provider evidence and bypass criteria remain internal.
Public abuse intake is server-validated, Turnstile/rate/idempotency controlled and no-store/noindex.
P16 actions operate on risk-controlled resources; broader administrator/user/workspace governance remains P17-owned.
Every high-risk action requires dedicated permission, actor, reason, correlation and immutable before/after audit.
Restore is never unconditional; current destination/domain safety authority must permit recovery.
Reports and notifications redact provider evidence, secrets and unnecessary PII.
Override authority is exact-fingerprint bound, expiry-bound and auditable.
Fingerprint change, expiry or incompatible policy authority invalidates the override.
Override mutation never changes P17 permission lifecycle and cannot bypass independent custom-domain axes.
P16 must not create a ninth production daemon; risk queue execution is contributed to the fixed eight-service architecture.
Queue jobs are durable/idempotent, carry correlation and recover abandoned/retryable work.
A worker crash/provider failure cannot leave an implicit allow runtime projection.
Use Design System exact tokens/components and preserve Admin shell authority rather than creating a parallel shell.
Browser evidence covers canonical desktop/tablet/mobile plus 320 CSS px reflow where applicable, keyboard/focus/name-role-value and reduced motion.
High-risk actions use visible triggers, reason/impact confirmation and persistent audit result; not hover-only or toast-only.
Public safety surfaces contain no target URL, provider name/evidence, threshold or continue-anyway action.
Direct URL loads and APIs repeat server permission/tenant checks; stale client state is never security authority.
P16 events preserve inherited P12 read-state, dedupe, deep-link authorization and secret-redaction contracts.
A notification is not risk decision or audit authority.
Security notification deep links reveal only context the recipient is authorized to read.

environment_contract.mysql: Real MySQL 8.x for durable scan jobs, risk decisions/history, domain reputation/revalidation, abuse reports/actions and audit evidence.
environment_contract.redis: Real Redis for inherited exact-fingerprint redirect projection plus queue/rate/idempotency coordination where implemented.
environment_contract.platformapi: Real native Go platformapi for public/admin trust APIs.
environment_contract.redirectengine: Real native Go redirectengine preserving inherited risk-before-routing safety order.
environment_contract.risk_worker: Fixed SVC-OPS-MONITOR operationsmonitor contribution; no ninth production daemon.
environment_contract.semantic_provider: Deterministic local provider/protocol fixtures in CI exercise real policy/error paths; live production provider credentials are prohibited.
environment_contract.ssrf: Controlled local DNS/HTTP fixtures exercise public/private/link-local/rebinding/redirect resolution without accessing external private networks.
environment_contract.turnstile: Inherited server-side deterministic CI verifier for public abuse intake; production bypass prohibited.
environment_contract.browser: Built Admin/Public surfaces with real local APIs and redirectengine where required.

closure.scope_rule: P16 closes its G6 trust/destination-risk/domain-risk/abuse contribution only. P17 administrator permission/governance and release-wide P20/P22 G10/G13 remain separately owned.

cases.name: Durable destination-risk schema and correlation
cases.oracle: Destination scan jobs, target observations, policy decisions and exact-fingerprint authority are durable, correlated and contain no raw provider secrets.

cases.name: Exact-fingerprint scan enqueue, dedupe and rescan
cases.oracle: Initial scan/rescan queueing is exact-fingerprint bound, idempotent under duplicate requests and never reuses authority for a different reachable-target set.

cases.name: Destination normalization and unsafe URL forms
cases.oracle: Only reviewed HTTP/HTTPS destination forms enter scanning; relative, userinfo, unsupported-scheme and malformed targets fail closed before provider access.

cases.name: SSRF address policy and DNS rebinding resistance
cases.oracle: Loopback, private, link-local, reserved/metadata addresses and DNS rebinding/redirect-to-private paths are rejected for target/provider inspection with no outbound bypass.

cases.name: Semantic provider and policy decision mapping
cases.oracle: Deterministic provider observations are normalized into versioned allow/review/block policy decisions without making any external provider the sole control authority.

cases.name: Provider outage, partial and malformed fail-closed behavior
cases.oracle: Timeout, transport error, partial response, malformed payload and unavailable provider states never become implicit allow and remain review/pending/unavailable according to policy.

cases.name: Risk worker idempotency, retry and recovery
cases.oracle: The P16 risk task contribution executes inside the fixed eight-service architecture, retries idempotently, recovers abandoned work and cannot produce duplicate final authority.

cases.name: Redis exact-fingerprint runtime projection
cases.oracle: Only a durable current decision is projected to the inherited Redis risk key for the exact link/fingerprint with bounded validity and policy version; stale projection is not authority.

cases.name: Runtime non-allow fail-closed matrix
cases.oracle: Missing, unknown, malformed, stale, pending, review, block and provider-unavailable states cannot reach any customer destination; exact current allow is the sole redirect authority.

cases.name: Official/custom parity across primary, routing and A/B targets
cases.oracle: The same normalized primary/routing/A-B target set and exact fingerprint receives identical destination-risk enforcement on official and custom hostnames.

cases.name: Target mutation invalidation and reorder stability
cases.oracle: Any reachable target mutation invalidates prior allow immediately, while semantically identical target reorder/deduplication does not create a bypass or false new approval.

cases.name: Manual destination override authority and audit
cases.oracle: Destination override requires security.manage, exact fingerprint, actor, non-empty reason, correlation, bounded validity/policy context and immutable audit; unauthorized/crafted requests fail closed.

cases.name: Override invalidation on fingerprint/policy authority change
cases.oracle: A manual override cannot survive a different target fingerprint, incompatible policy version, expiry or explicitly invalidating provider/policy authority change.

cases.name: Redirect safety ordering and target non-disclosure
cases.oracle: Inherited redirect ordering remains link/domain authority then exact-current risk allow before routing/A-B/UTM/access; safety responses expose no unsafe target, provider evidence or continue-anyway path.

cases.name: Durable domain reputation decision and independent axes
cases.oracle: Domain reputation/review evidence is durable and domain risk remains independent from entitlement, ownership, ingress DNS and HTTPS; only risk allow can satisfy the inherited risk axis.

cases.name: Domain risk revalidation lifecycle and stale handling
cases.oracle: Revalidation is rate/idempotency controlled, records last/next policy check, enters revalidating/pending safely and stale decisions fail closed without overwriting other domain axes.

cases.name: Domain reputation provider failure and partial evidence
cases.oracle: Domain provider outage/partial/malformed results cannot produce allow; safe reason categories are user-visible while provider evidence remains internal and redacted.

cases.name: Immediate security/abuse suspension without grace
cases.oracle: A validated security/abuse action immediately suspends affected P16-controlled link/domain risk authority with no billing/domain grace fallback or official-host fallback.

cases.name: Public abuse report validation, Turnstile and rate authority
cases.oracle: POST /api/public/abuse-reports validates allowlisted report fields, verifies Turnstile server-side, rate/idempotency controls duplicate intake and returns persistent safe success without exposing internal state.

cases.name: Abuse evidence correlation and secret/PII minimization
cases.oracle: Abuse reports correlate safe resource/workspace/request identifiers and evidence references while ordinary logs/audit/CI redact raw provider evidence, secrets and unnecessary PII.

cases.name: Admin abuse lifecycle
cases.oracle: Authorized admin review moves reports through open/investigating/resolved/dismissed with reasoned immutable audit and optimistic/idempotent conflict handling.

cases.name: Abuse resource action, recovery and audit
cases.oracle: P16 risk-controlled suspend/block/restore actions require security.manage, reason and correlation; restore succeeds only when current safety authority allows it, with immutable before/after audit.

cases.name: Security/domain notification producer contract
cases.oracle: P16 produces deduplicated, redacted, authorization-safe security/domain/resource notifications with valid deep-link context while preserving the inherited P12 notification-center authority.

cases.name: Admin destination-risk API and RBAC
cases.oracle: Destination-risk list/detail/rescan/override APIs require server-side security.manage, consistent errors/rate/idempotency where applicable, no cross-tenant leakage and complete reason/audit authority.

cases.name: Admin domain-risk API and RBAC
cases.oracle: GET/list/detail and POST revalidate domain-risk APIs require domains.risk.manage for actions, preserve independent domain axes, rate/idempotency/error/audit rules and no cross-tenant leakage.

cases.name: Admin Trust & Safety browser authority
cases.oracle: Real built Admin destination-risk/domain-risk/abuse surfaces cover required IA states, dedicated permission denials, rescan/override/abuse confirmations, provider-partial/stale behavior, audit result, accessibility and no-store/noindex.

cases.name: Public safety and abuse-report browser authority
cases.oracle: Real public safety/interstitial and abuse-report surfaces preserve noindex/no-store as applicable, allowlisted copy, target/provider non-disclosure, Turnstile/rate/error/persistent-success states, responsive/accessibility and no bypass link.

cases.name: Exact-head P16 evidence coherence
cases.oracle: All P16-T001..P16-T027 evidence is producer-coherent, secret-safe, reviewable and bound to the same exact implementation revision; mixed-head or unsafe evidence is rejected.

cases.name: Accountable signed exact-head closure
cases.oracle: Signed review, P16-T001..P16-T028, complete affected exact-head regression matrix, inherited signed authorities and defect ledger agree on one signed revision with P0/P1/DECISION REQUIRED all zero.
